facility.name: Bertha Academy LLC
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Meals Provided ,Snacks Provided,Skill Classes

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 6402 SARATOGA BLVD, CORPUS CHRISTI, TX, 78414

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records: Out of the ten children's records monitored, two were missing the emergency care authorization, one was missing the special care statement, one was missing the healthcare provider statement, and three were missing current and updated immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records (26 TAC §746.801(1))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The annual fire inspection was observed to be expired.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: One out of the 8 records monitored did not have a record ready for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Care Requirements for Toddlers - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers: In the toddler/prek3 classroom, two year old children were observed and choking hazards were present in the play areas, in access to children under the age of 3.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Care Requirements for Toddlers - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers (26 TAC §746.2501(5))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: In the infant classroom, infant equipment currently used was observed to be unsanitary.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: One out of the eight staff records monitored did not have the in person training that is required to complete the on line certification training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization: The operation's staff did not report to Child Care Regulation, a child's injury that required medical attention.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Opening/Closing: The operation combined infant aged children with 18m and older children, in the music room, when combing for the 45 minutes prior to closing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Opening/Closing (26 TAC §746.1615)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation: The center director did not have a current CPR and First Aid certification training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records: The outdoor monthly checklists have not been completed since May of 2025 and are not current.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records (26 TAC §746.801(8))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: 4 out of the 10 children's records monitored, did not have up-to-date immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required: 3 out of the 5 staff records monitored, did not have their annual training current for Shaken Baby Syndrome, Sudden Infant Death Syndrome, and Early Childhood Brain Development.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required (26 TAC §746.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Child Becomes Ill in Care and Requires Immediate Treatment or Hospitalization - Contact EMS or take to ER: The operation's staff did not make the decision to call for emergency services when a child showed an urgent need for medical care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child Becomes Ill in Care and Requires Immediate Treatment or Hospitalization - Contact EMS or take to ER (26 TAC §746.3605(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out: Children were placed in a highchair for approximately 5-10 minutes as a form of discipline.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out (26 TAC §746.2805(8))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised: Infant children were left unsupervised when a caregiver left her classroom for a restroom break and asked a second caregiver to supervise them when that caregiver was caring for a separate group of children in a different room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised (26 TAC §746.2401(7))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: One infant classroom caregiver was observed on her personal cell phone while she was supervising children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: 10 children were observed eating in highchairs and were observed  to not be strapped to their seats that require seat straps.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing Before Eating: 10 children in the toddler/ PreK mixed classroom did not wash their hands prior to eating their food.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing Before Eating (26 TAC §746.3417(1))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: Inspector observed one caregiver on their cell phone while caring for children. Inspector spoke to staff who stated they are not allowed to be on their cell phones when in a classroom with children. Inspector has previously provided technical assistance on staff on cell phones while caring for children during a previous inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone: Inspector observed one person present and in a classroom with unsupervised access to children without an initial background check submitted. At the time of inspection the caregiver was seen in multiple classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone (26 TAC §745.621(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible: Based on the information provided during the course of the investigation, two infants were observed being left asleep in car seats while in care at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Inspector observed two classrooms out of ratio.     The infant room had 11 infants with one caregiver. The caregiver did not know the ages of the infants except that the youngest infant was one month old.     A second classroom had one caregiver with 23 children. The children were between 2-4 yrs. old. The specified age group was 3 yrs. old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Smoke Detectors Testing: The operation did not have annual documentation for checking the carbon monoxide, smoke detector, or fire extinguishers monthly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §746.5319)

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures: The emergency preparedness plan was missing information such as how children with limited mobility or who are under 24 months will be evacuated, and how staff will continue to care for children until parents arrive.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area: Inspector observed two classrooms change children and not sanitize the diaper changing table after each child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3505(e))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Never Prop Bottles: Inspector observed one 6 month old infant in a bouncer with a blanket and bottle. Staff stated the blanket was being used to prop bottle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Never Prop Bottles (26 TAC §746.2419(3))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: One staff left classroom to open the door leaving the classroom out of ratio. There was one staff with 8 infants until the second staff returned.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: Inspector observed one 4 month old  infant in a crib lying on a boppy pillow.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Several classrooms were observed to have chipped paint on walls which is accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: Two stationary play structures (one blue Thomas the Train and one red/pink fire truck) was observed with broken plastic parts. The broken plastic was observed to be sharp with jagged edges which poses a risk to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes: One child, age five months old, was observed sitting in a bouncy seat for almost thirty minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes (26 TAC §746.2417(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants-Hold through 6-months: A caregiver in the infant room was observed feeding a child with bottle while child was sitting in a bouncer seat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants-Hold through 6-months (26 TAC §746.2419(1))

occurrences.finding: Posting of Activity Plan: Two out of six classrooms observed did not have an activity plan posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting of Activity Plan (26 TAC §746.2209)

occurrences.finding: Alternate Activity for Non-sleeping Children: One child was observed awake sitting in a stroller during naptime.  NOTE: this was corrected at time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Alternate Activity for Non-sleeping Children (26 TAC §746.2907(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: A caregiver was observed talking to another caregiver through the door to which her back was turned toward the children resulting in one child crawling out the doorway and into the hallway.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders: In one classroom, childrens' snack was not placed on a plate or napkin prior to serving.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders (26 TAC §746.3317(6))
